titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, The Guardian
mainText: The Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention called a crisis meeting following an Ebola case reported in Nigeria.
France confirmed a human infection with Shamonda livestock virus.
France confirms first human infection with Shamonda livestock virus.
Russia and Ukraine conducted military strikes overnight, and Moscow indicated willingness to engage in peace talks.
The International Criminal Court received the EU's Sakharov Prize.
